recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, reclining portrait of a man in a tan wool suit and fedora, set against a dark, textured brown background. The subject is posed on a high-pile shag rug, illuminated by a strong rim light that creates a glowing halo effect around his silhouette, emphasizing the textures of the fabric and skin.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's diagonal reclining pose against a static horizontal ground
High-contrast rim lighting against a dark, matte background
Monochromatic color harmony between clothing, skin, and environment
Textural contrast between coarse wool, soft fur, and smooth skin
coreInvariants: Strict earth-tone palette (tan, beige, chocolate brown)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, reclining from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and fedora, highlighted by the brightest point of the rim light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left typography, follows the diagonal line of the leg down to the hands, and moves up to the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of dark brown negative space in the upper third of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Chocolate brown background providing depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Tan and beige tones in the suit and rug acting as the mid-tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm white rim light creating highlights and separation.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on value contrast; deep shadows and bright highlights with minimal color variety.

letterConstructionRules: Extended swashes on terminal ends (especially B and N)
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'B' features a large, curling swash that underlines the letter
The 'N' features a descending swash that curls back toward the center

treatment.shadow: inner glow and outer drop shadow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative display face used for maximum impact without secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar heavy serif structure with decorative terminals.
Captures the classic, slightly weathered feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man in a tan wool suit and fedora reclining on a beige shag rug. Dark brown studio background. Strong white rim lighting from behind the subject creating a glow. Cinematic film grain, low angle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, beveled, tan-colored decorative serif text in the top left corner. Use custom swashes on the first and last letters. Add a soft drop shadow to create depth against the dark background.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting primarily coming from behind the subject?
Is the color palette strictly limited to earth tones?
Does the typography have a 3D beveled appearance?
Is the texture of the suit and rug clearly visible?

mustRedesign: Any specific facial features of the subject
Unique tattoo patterns on the neck and hands
postGenerationChecks: Confirm the rim light creates a distinct halo effect.
Ensure the typography feels integrated into the 3D space via shadows.
Verify the film grain is consistent across the entire image.
Check that the pose maintains a diagonal composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle, rim-lit portrait in monochromatic earth tones with 3D-beveled swash typography in the negative space to create a classic, high-texture editorial aesthetic.
